Body.Content: The Azure Search .NET SDK is now generally available. You can download the SDK package from NuGet. The version number of the GA package is 1.1, and it targets version 2015-02-28 of the Azure Search REST API. The GA release of the .NET SDK includes support for the Lucene query syntax and the new serialization features introduced in version 1.0-preview. To learn more, see Upgrading to the Azure Search .NET SDK version 1.1.
Body.Markdown:
The Azure Search .NET SDK is now generally available. You can download the SDK package from NuGet . The version number of the GA package is 1.1, and it targets version 2015-02-28 of the Azure Search REST API.

The GA release of the .NET SDK includes support for the Lucene query syntax and the new serialization features introduced in version 1.0-preview. This version contains several breaking changes from older versions (0.13.0-preview and earlier). These changes are mostly minor, so changing your code should require only minimal effort.

To learn more, see Upgrading to the Azure Search .NET SDK version 1.1 .
